title: 3BR 30A Vacation Home with a Private Pool & Beach Access
meta_description: Stay at Southern Grounds, a spacious 3BR, 3BA 30A vacation home with a private pool, beach access, a large deck, and a full kitchen. Sleeps 9.
description_expanded: Come enjoy Southern Grounds, a home conveniently located directly north of 30A, on the quaint street of Montigo Avenue in the heart of Seagrove Beach! This strikingly spacious 3 bedroom, 3 bath property will sleep up to 9 people and is just a short walk or bike to the beach! This beautiful street is located less than one mile from both Seaside and Watercolor – only a short walk, bike or drive to fun family activities, delicious restaurants, and desirable boutiques in the surrounding communities.1st Floor:Large deck space, great for entertainingLiving area with a comfy couch and two chairsOpen Kitchen and Dining area, seating for 4 at the bartop, and 6 at the dining tableBedroom 1: Full-over-full bunk bedroom with twin trundle, TVFull bath with w/ easy access for all first floor guests2nd Floor:Bedroom 2: King master suite with sitting area and TV. Private bath with double vanities, glass enclosed shower, and large soaking tubBedroom 3: Queen bed with private bathroom. Tub/shower combo.Both bedrooms have access to beautiful outdoor balconies for more relaxing or entertaining space.Outside:Enjoy the sunshine by the large pool. This area makes a great place to gather with a dining table, grill and plenty of lounge chairs. There's also an outdoor bathroom and mini kitchenette (sink and mini fridge). The private pool is perfect for entertaining and relaxing. There is plenty of seating outside and views of the pool from the balconies.Your stay at Southern Grounds comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for several cars both under the house as well as in the very long drivewayDisclaimer:We apologize in advance, but some nearby lots in Southern Grounds are being developed, so you may notice occasional construction noise or activity.A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
